tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Antibacterial and antitumor activities of cyclic tetrapeptides (CtetPs).
footnotes: a Minimal inhibitory concentrations (MICs) were defined as the lowest concentration at which no growth was detectable for 24 h. Tetracycline was used as positive control. b IC50 were recorded as the concentration (μM) at which cells were reduced 50% in 48 h. Taxol was used as positive control.
